---
title: "pressR saddle pressure report"
output: html_document
header-includes:
  - \usepackage{longtable}
params:
  trial: NULL
  masks: NULL
  thresholds: NULL
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5)
library(pressR)
```

```{r}
trial <- params$trial
```

## Trial

```{r}
.report_table(pr_report_info(trial))
```

## Regional pressures

```{r}
masks <- if (is.null(params$masks)) pr_mask_saddle_6(trial$layout) else params$masks
.report_table(.report_regional_table(trial, masks), digits=2)
```

## Composite report

```{r, fig.width=9, fig.height=7, fig.alt="Four panels show the maximum sensor map with selected regions, regional maxima, center of pressure trajectory, and left/right peak-measurement symmetry."}
pr_plot_saddle_report(trial, thresholds = params$thresholds, masks = masks)
```

## Bridge detection

```{r}
bridge <- pr_calc_saddle_bridge(trial, masks = masks)
.report_table(data.frame(parameter=c("Middle / ends ratio", "Below exploratory threshold"),
                       value=c(as.character(round(bridge$bridge_ratio,3)),as.character(bridge$is_bridged))))
```

## Slip analysis

```{r}
slip <- pr_calc_saddle_slip(trial)
.report_table(data.frame(parameter=c("Mean symmetry index (%)", "Maximum absolute symmetry index (%)", "Dominant side", "Above exploratory threshold"),
                       value=c(round(slip$symmetry_index_mean,2),round(slip$symmetry_index_max,2),slip$dominant_side,slip$is_asymmetric)))
```

## Interpretation and provenance

`NA` indicates an unavailable physical quantity or insufficient measurements. Region definitions and
reference observations must match the acquisition and analysis context.
Exploratory bridge, slip and concentration settings are not diagnostic rules.

```{r}
if (!is.null(params$thresholds)) .report_table(params$thresholds)
```
